description: Add 4 long-running session templates (init.sh, feature_list.json, progress.log.md, session_handoff.md) under templates/.
Wire templates/ into skills/build/SKILL.md so a >1 session task emits them by default.
Add test fixtures (tests/test_long_running_templates.py) validating file existence, JSON shape, and bash syntax for every template.
Document the >1-session workflow in templates/progress.log.md (Goal / Work done / Tests status / Blockers / Next session should / Commits).
Author templates/session_handoff.md as a resume-from-cold-context checklist (where to start, what to verify, what to avoid).
Verify init.sh exits non-zero when feature_list.json is missing and runs a successful baseline when present.
Register Linear issue for Pattern 2 implementation and create PR once all tests pass.
